lines.say: Bud Light's parent owns Modelo. So why does a rival sell it?

lines.text: In 2013, the Justice Department made AB InBev hand Modelo's US rights to Constellation Brands.
lines.say: In twenty thirteen, the Justice Department made A B InBev hand Modelo's US rights to Constellation Brands.

lines.text: Constellation paid $2.9 billion for a Mexican brewery and perpetual US brand rights.
lines.say: Constellation paid two point nine billion dollars for a brewery and those rights.

lines.text: Beer sales grew from $2.8 billion in fiscal 2014 to $8.3 billion in fiscal 2026.
lines.say: Beer sales grew from two point eight billion dollars in fiscal twenty fourteen to eight point three billion.

lines.text: After the 2023 Bud Light boycott, Modelo Especial passed it in US retail dollar sales (June 2023).
lines.say: After the twenty twenty-three Bud Light boycott, Modelo passed it in retail dollar sales.

lines.text: Michelob Ultra took the volume lead in 2025, but Modelo still led in dollars as of October 2026, per Constellation.
lines.say: Michelob Ultra took the volume lead in twenty twenty-five, but Modelo still led in dollars as of October twenty twenty-six.

lines.text: In fiscal 2026 (ended February 2026), beer's operating margin was 38.0%.
lines.say: In fiscal twenty twenty-six, beer's operating margin was thirty-eight percent.

lines.text: Math: $10 of beer sales x 38% = about $3.80 of operating profit.
lines.say: That's about three dollars and eighty cents of operating profit per ten dollars of sales.

lines.text: But in FY2026, beer sales fell 3%, and aluminum tariffs raised costs.
lines.say: But that year, beer sales fell three percent, and aluminum tariffs raised costs.

post.title: Bud Light's parent owns Modelo. Why does a rival sell it?
post.ig:
Bud Light's parent owns Modelo. So why does Constellation Brands sell it in the US?

In 2013 the DOJ cleared AB InBev's Grupo Modelo deal only if the US rights went to Constellation, which paid $2.9B for a brewery and perpetual US brand rights.
Constellation's beer net sales grew from $2.8B (FY2014) to $8.3B (FY2026), with a 38.0% operating margin.
Modelo Especial passed Bud Light in retail dollar sales in June 2023; Constellation said in October 2026 it is still No. 1 by dollars. Michelob Ultra leads by volume.
FY2026 beer sales fell 3% as shipment volumes dropped and aluminum tariffs raised costs.

Sources: Constellation Brands FY2026 and Q2 FY2027 results, 2013 deal filing; US DOJ; Circana via Fox Business, CNN.
